mechanism: Both drugs are dopamine antagonists that additively increase risk of extrapyramidal side effects and neuroleptic malignant syndrome through combined D2 receptor blockade in the basal ganglia and CNS.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses, monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, dystonia, akathisia, and signs of neuroleptic malignant syndrome (fever, rigidity, altered mental status).
